A MANAGEMENT COMPANY WITH A LICENSE FROM THE CAPITAL MARKET, INSURANCE AND SAVINGS AUTHORITY COMMISSIONER IN ISRAEL OR 2. AN INSURER WITH A FOREIGN INSURER LICENSE FROM THE COMMISSIONER IN ISRAEL. THE DEFINITIONS REFER TO THE FINANCIAL SERVICES (PENSION FUNDS) SUPERVISION LAW 2005. THEREFORE, A MANAGEMENT COMPANY IS A COMPANY WITH A LICENSE FROM THE CAPITAL MARKET, INSURANCE AND SAVINGS AUTHORITY COMMISSIONER IN ISRAEL. PENSION FUND - RECEIVED APPROVAL UNDER SECTION 13 OF THE LAW FROM THE CAPITAL MARKET, INSURANCE AND SAVINGS AUTHORITY COMMISSIONER IN ISRAEL.
